channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping leads Thanksgiving Day with $11.6 million
item.description: The Hunger Games prequel topped Thanksgiving Day in its second week and is projected to make about $85 million over the five-day holiday.

item.title: GTA VI estimated at 53 million copies, already the 13th best-selling game ever
item.description: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold about 53 million copies and $4.7 billion in its first week, GamesRadar+ reports.

item.title: OpenAI fixes a GPT-6.2 billing error, so users hit limits up to 40% faster
item.description: OpenAI says a launch-period error over-discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage, so after the fix usage limits arrive sooner.

item.title: Nvidia reportedly pauses AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
item.description: Nvidia has reportedly told partners including Dell and Super Micro to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia.

item.title: Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade runs today after its first-ever weather delay
item.description: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade moved to Saturday, November 28, after a nor'easter brought gusts above the balloon safety limit.

item.title: PS5 stock stays extremely limited in the US through Black Friday
item.description: TechRadar says US PS5 stock is extremely limited, blaming global memory shortages and GTA VI, while UK retailers restock some bundles.

item.title: Silksong's free Sea of Sorrow expansion arrives on December 11
item.description: Team Cherry confirmed the date in its Cherry Time! showcase and also launched a publishing label, Team Cherry Presents.

item.title: Anthropic reportedly buys Stainless, the SDK maker used by OpenAI and Google
item.description: Anthropic has reportedly acquired Stainless for over $300 million, and Stainless's hosted services for other clients are set to end.

item.title: Ransomware gang's November 28 leak deadline for Nvidia arrives
item.description: The Gentlemen ransomware group claims to have Nvidia data and set today as its leak deadline. Nvidia says it sees no sign its systems were hit.

item.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million AI data centre satellites
item.description: The FCC has given SpaceX conditional approval for Starmind, a planned network of up to one million computing satellites in orbit.

item.title: Focker-In-Law takes No. 2 on Thanksgiving Day with $7.7 million
item.description: The fourth Meet the Parents film made $7.7 million on Thanksgiving Day and is projected to take about $40 million over five days.

item.title: Disney's Hexed lands third on Thanksgiving Day, below its early tracking
item.description: Disney's animated Hexed made about $4.5 million on Thanksgiving Day and is projected near $34 million over five days.

item.title: Ubisoft says generative AI is not required after a report on pitch rules
item.description: Ubisoft says its projects are not required to use generative AI, after Vertical Slice reported teams must justify not using it.

item.title: S&P puts Nvidia on watch for a possible credit downgrade
item.description: S&P Global placed Nvidia's AA ratings on negative CreditWatch, citing governance concerns after Jensen Huang's exit and return as CEO.

item.title: Netflix's The Trials of Karen Read tops US streaming charts
item.description: The three-part docuseries about the Karen Read case was Netflix's No. 1 US show on November 24 and 25, according to FlixPatrol.

item.title: SAP is reportedly weighing at least 10,000 job cuts in an AI overhaul
item.description: Bloomberg reports SAP is considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs, about 9% of its staff, as it restructures around AI.

item.title: US chip curbs are reportedly slowing Chinese AI labs' next models
item.description: Reuters reports Z.AI is behind schedule on its next flagship model as US chip curbs and a distillation crackdown bite.

item.title: Rockstar UK staff vote 75% against union recognition
item.description: Rockstar's UK employees voted 75% to 25% against recognising the IWGB union, on a turnout of just over 93%.

item.title: AI shopping agents' traffic to US retailers is estimated up 150-fold
item.description: Human Security estimates AI agent traffic to US retail sites has risen about 150-fold this holiday season.

item.title: Mario Kart World's free update adds eight remixed tracks
item.description: Nintendo's version 1.9.0 update for the Switch 2 racer adds eight returning tracks, two Knockout Tour routes and automatic replay saving.

item.title: X launches parental controls for teen accounts
item.description: X now lets parents supervise accounts of users aged 13 to 17, which default to a protected mode, TechCrunch reports.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer
item.description: Amazon's eight-episode Blade Runner series premiered on November 25 and holds a 70% critics' score on Rotten Tomatoes.

item.title: Switzerland says AI agents were used in five recent cyberattacks
item.description: Switzerland's federal cybersecurity office reports five recent attacks involving AI agents against businesses and infrastructure operators.

item.title: Playground says Fable has more than 150,000 lines of dialogue
item.description: Fable's general manager Ralph Fulton says the game has more than 150,000 lines of dialogue and over 100 voice actors.

item.title: Dutch consumer groups sue to halt Meta's AI glasses in the Netherlands
item.description: Consumentenbond and Offlimits filed a suit in Amsterdam claiming Meta's AI glasses allow covert filming that breaches EU privacy law.

item.title: Google's Cogentic research agent posts six maths papers in a single day
item.description: A Google Research AI agent built with Gemini 4 produced six mathematics papers on November 25 and posted them publicly on GitHub.

item.title: Brad Pitt's Cliff Booth film makes about $910,000 on its IMAX opening day
item.description: Netflix's IMAX-only release of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is projected to make about $3.5 million over five days.

item.title: New Switch 2 hack lets jailbroken consoles run dumped games
item.description: An open-source tool called nx2-relink turns Switch 2 game dumps into homebrew programs that run natively, tbreak reports.

item.title: Microsoft says state hackers have adopted the ARTEX AI hacking tool
item.description: Microsoft says state-backed groups from China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, now use the AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX.

item.title: Capcom will shut down Exoprimal's servers in September 2027
item.description: Capcom will delist its dinosaur hero shooter and its DLC on March 30, 2027, and close the servers on September 29, 2027.

item.title: Huawei teases its next AI memory chip to rival Samsung and SK Hynix
item.description: Huawei has teased a next-generation high-bandwidth memory chip for AI, Bloomberg reports, aiming at Samsung and SK Hynix.

item.title: Denny's restores Jensen Huang's plaque after his return to Nvidia
item.description: Denny's posted on X that it had restored a commemorative plaque to Nvidia's CEO and invited him back to his booth.

item.title: Canada adds C$700 million to its AI compute fund and will cover up to 80%
item.description: Canada expanded its AI Compute Access Fund to C$1 billion and will cover up to 80% of eligible costs bought from sovereign providers.

item.title: Lords of the Fallen II slips again, now to April 2027
item.description: CI Games' CEO says the soulslike sequel will launch in April 2027, with the exact date to be announced in December.

item.title: CBS says Nvidia sold top chips to two Chinese-owned California firms
item.description: A CBS News investigation says Nvidia sold some of its most advanced chips to two Chinese-owned California companies.

item.title: Anthropic says Claude agents moved its API from Python to Rust
item.description: Anthropic reports that Claude agents migrated its Messages API to Rust, cutting processor use per request by about 70%.

item.title: Jennifer Lopez's Las Vegas residency film airs on CBS and Paramount+
item.description: The JLo Show: Live in Las Vegas aired on CBS on Thanksgiving night, with an extended version streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Fans think EA's Iron Man game could appear at The Game Awards
item.description: A refreshed EA Motive website has fans speculating that its long-quiet Iron Man game will show up at The Game Awards on December 10.

item.title: EU may vote on approving Tesla's assisted driving system on December 15
item.description: A draft European Commission agenda shows a possible vote on authorising Tesla's assisted driving system at a December 15 meeting, Reuters reports.

item.title: Japanese residents push back against data centres built near homes
item.description: Reuters reports growing resistance from urban residents in Japan as data centres for AI computing move into neighbourhoods.

item.title: The Hunting Wives returns to Netflix with an eight-episode second season
item.description: Netflix released all eight episodes of The Hunting Wives' second season on November 26, with Malin Akerman and Brittany Snow back.

item.title: Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie's comedy Dig lands on Peacock
item.description: Peacock released all ten episodes of Dig, a comedy co-run by Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin, on November 23.
